from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit_algorithms.minimum_eigen_solvers import QAOA
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from qiskit_optimization.translators import to_docplex_mp
import networkx as nx

def solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size, p_layers=2, penalty=2.5, opt_shots=512, final_shots=4096, maxiter=80, seed=42):
    # Create a NetworkX graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    
    # Convert the graph to a quadratic program
    dp = to_docplex_mp.max_vertex_cover(G)
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    qp.from_docplex_mp(dp)
    
    # Convert the quadratic program to a QUBO
    conv = QuadraticProgramToQubo(penalty=penalty)
    qubo = conv.convert(qp)
    
    # Set up the QAOA solver
    backend = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=seed)
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=maxiter)
    qaoa = QAOA(backend, optimizer, p=p_layers)
    
    # Solve the QUBO
    result = qaoa.solve(qubo)
    
    # Extract the solution
    x = result.x
    independent_set = [graph_vertices[i] for i in range(len(x)) if x[i] == 1]
    independent_set_size = len(independent_set)
    
    # Calculate the metrics
    independent_set_ratio = independent_set_size / len(graph_vertices)
    validity_rate = 1 if nx.is_independent_set(G, independent_set) else 0
    embedding_overhead = 0  # Assuming no overhead in this simple case
    resource_cost = len(graph_vertices) - independent_set_size  # Tasks not in the independent set
    
    return {
        "independent_set_ratio": independent_set_ratio,
        "validity_rate": validity_rate,
        "embedding_overhead": embedding_overhead,
        "resource_cost": resource_cost
    }

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    graph_vertices = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7"]
    graph_edges = [
        ["T1", "T2"],
        ["T1", "T3"],
        ["T2", "T3"],
        ["T3", "T4"],
        ["T4", "T5"],
        ["T5", "T6"],
        ["T6", "T7"],
        ["T2", "T7"]
    ]
    optimal_independent_set_size = 3
    result = solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size)
    print(result)
